title: osf review: multi-agent PR review pipeline
summary: Adds a whole review subsystem to osf: a lens catalogue (20 shipped lenses plus repository overrides), a reviewer roster resolved from `[agents]` in osf.toml, per-reviewer headless runs of coding agents (codex, claude, opencode, omp) inside a clean copy of the change, quote verification of every finding against the real files, a deterministic reducer that turns answers into a verdict, and a new `review.yml` GitHub workflow that builds osf from the base branch, fans out one job per reviewer with only that provider's key, then reduces and posts. It also reworks suppression so a marker naming another checker's rule is neither applied nor reported unused, and adds diff-content signals (public surface, concurrency, repeated logic, hot paths) that select lenses.

lanes.subtitle: review.yml, base-branch trusted

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: pull_request_target, advisory
nodes.summary: Builds osf from the base branch, fans out reviewer jobs, then reduces and posts. Holds no provider key in the build or reduce job; each reviewer job gets only its own provider's key and a network allowlist.

nodes.label: review build
nodes.subtitle: base branch only, no secrets
nodes.summary: Checks out the base branch, builds osf in the pinned devcontainer image, downloads and checksums the codex release, and finds the work item with a read-only token. Uploads osf, codex and the work item as artifacts.

nodes.label: reviewer jobs
nodes.subtitle: codex, claude, opencode
nodes.summary: One job per reviewer, each in its own environment holding only its own provider key, each with an egress allowlist naming only its provider's host. Each runs `osf review run --reviewer <name>` and uploads the saved answers.

nodes.label: review reduce
nodes.subtitle: collects, decides, posts
nodes.summary: Downloads every reviewer's saved answers, mints the verifier app token, and runs `osf review reduce` with `--post-to`. A reviewer with no saved answers counts as could-not-run, which never passes.

nodes.label: review-fork-disabled
nodes.subtitle: fails loudly
nodes.summary: A fork's pull request with OSF_REVIEW_FORKS unset fails this job rather than skipping, so an unconfigured adopter cannot let a fork pass the check.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: --reviewer, --if-enabled, --config-root
nodes.summary: Selects lenses, runs the roster over each, checks findings, decides and journals. With `--reviewer` it runs one reviewer and saves what it did for the reduce step.

nodes.label: osf review reduce
nodes.subtitle: saved runs to one verdict
nodes.summary: Loads each saved reviewer file, binds it to this pull request, commit and CI run, re-validates every answer, checks quotes, journals and posts.

nodes.label: osf review work-item
nodes.subtitle: issue on the Issue line
nodes.summary: Finds the issue a pull request names or closes and saves its text, or the reason it has none, for the reviewer jobs.

nodes.label: osf agents list
nodes.subtitle: table or --json
nodes.summary: Prints every agent osf can drive with what `[agents]` selects: enabled, builder, reviewer, model and hook settings path.

nodes.label: hooks install --agents
nodes.subtitle: writes each agent's settings
nodes.summary: Writes the stop and prompt hook settings of every enabled agent under `--root`, replacing a file already there.

nodes.label: osf scan
nodes.subtitle: --no-suppress
nodes.summary: Gains `--no-suppress`, which ignores every osf-disable marker; CI now runs scan with it. Suppression is applied per checker with an owned-rule set.

nodes.label: lens catalogue
nodes.subtitle: 20 shipped lenses
nodes.summary: Loads the shipped lenses, then an organisation folder, then the repository's `.osf/review-lenses/*.toml`, a later file replacing an earlier lens of the same name. Selects lenses by run mode, path trigger or signal trigger.

nodes.label: reviewer roster
nodes.subtitle: from [agents] in osf.toml
nodes.summary: Resolves the enabled agents, builder and reviewers from the trusted config root, and builds each reviewer's command, read-only switches, credential variables and login paths.

nodes.label: review context
nodes.subtitle: metadata, redacted
nodes.summary: Assembles the pull request, commits, changed files, work item and decision records into the prompt's metadata section, redacting any secret osf's own scan rules match. Also writes the read-only change.diff folder.

nodes.label: review prompt
nodes.subtitle: placeholders + answer format
nodes.summary: Fills the shipped or repository prompt file's placeholders and appends the fixed answer format, so no file can break parsing.

nodes.label: answer schema
nodes.subtitle: jsonschema validation
nodes.summary: Validates a reviewer's final message against the review-answer JSON Schema, then checks the lens name and that every criterion has a score. Falls back to fenced code blocks, last to first.

nodes.label: quote verification
nodes.subtitle: VerifiedAnswer
nodes.summary: Checks each finding's quote against the file and line it names, with a two-line tolerance and a minimum length, refusing paths outside the repository. Only a VerifiedAnswer can be scored.

nodes.label: reducer
nodes.subtitle: quorum, blockers, threshold
nodes.summary: Turns verified answers into one verdict per lens and one for the review: two families with two rounds each, a critical-round fallback for one family, blockers veto, weighted mean against the threshold.

nodes.label: builder family detection
nodes.subtitle: Code-Generator trailers
nodes.summary: Reads each commit's `Code-Generator:` trailer and maps the model to a family, so a reviewer from the family that built the change sits that change out.

nodes.label: clean copy
nodes.subtitle: no agent settings, no symlinks
nodes.summary: Copies the change's tracked and untracked files into a temp folder, leaving out every coding agent's project settings and every symbolic link, so the change cannot configure the agent that reviews it.

nodes.label: changeset risk
nodes.subtitle: diff-content signals
nodes.summary: Gains signals read from diff content rather than paths: public surface, concurrency, new-file, repeated-logic and configured hot paths. `assess` now takes a separate config root.

nodes.label: suppression engine
nodes.subtitle: owned rules
nodes.summary: `apply_suppressions` takes a known-rule set and an owned-rule set: a marker naming only another checker's rule is invisible, neither suppressing nor reported unused. A marker with no reason no longer suppresses.

nodes.label: journal
nodes.subtitle: ReviewAnswer, ReviewDecision
nodes.summary: Two new payloads record each reviewer's outcome and the whole review's verdict. The transcript path is dropped from the replay hash so a run hashes the same whatever its temp path.

nodes.label: codex
nodes.subtitle: openai, read-only sandbox
nodes.summary: Runs `codex exec` with `--sandbox read-only`, `--output-schema` and `CODEX_API_KEY`. Its sandbox check must start on the runner or the reviewer never runs.

nodes.label: claude
nodes.subtitle: anthropic, file tools only
nodes.summary: Runs `claude --print --output-format json` with `--restricted`, `--tools Read,Grep,Glob` and `--json-schema` inline; the answer sits under the envelope's `structured_output`.

nodes.label: opencode
nodes.subtitle: openrouter, permissions denied
nodes.summary: Runs `opencode run --format json` with `--pure` and `OPENCODE_PERMISSION` denying edit, task, webfetch and bash.

nodes.label: omp
nodes.subtitle: many families, read tools
nodes.summary: Runs `omp` with `--no-extensions --no-skills --no-rules` and `--tools read,grep,glob`. Its family comes from its model.

nodes.label: provider APIs
nodes.subtitle: api.openai.com, api.anthropic.com, openrouter.ai
nodes.summary: The model providers each reviewer job reaches, one host per job's egress allowlist.

edges.label: osf binary, work item, codex release
review-run-*.json artifacts
edges.summary: Each reviewer job uploads its saved answers; the reduce job downloads them all and decides. This is the fan-in the change is really about.

flows.title: One reviewer job: run, save, reduce, post
flows.summary: A reviewer job starts in the pull request's own checkout, runs one reviewer over every selected lens inside a clean copy, saves the answers, and the reduce job turns every reviewer's saved answers into one verdict and posts it.

messages.label: copy the change, no agent settings
prompt + schema, read-only sandbox
messages.note: Two independent rounds per lens, plus a critical round when the reviewer answered at all.

views.title: Review system containers
views.summary: The new review pipeline end to end: the workflow's jobs, the osf commands they drive, the review core, and the coding agents each reviewer job runs.

views.title: Review core internals
views.summary: Inside the review core: how a lens is selected, a prompt assembled, an answer validated, a quote verified and a verdict decided.

views.title: Reviewer isolation boundary
views.summary: What each reviewer job can reach: its own provider's host, its own credential, and a clean copy of the change with no agent settings in it.

steps.heading: Build from the base branch
steps.body: The build job runs only base-branch code, holds no provider key, and finds the work item with a read-only token.

steps.heading: Fan out one job per reviewer
steps.body: Each reviewer job gets only its own provider's key and an egress allowlist naming only its provider's host.

steps.heading: Run inside a clean copy
steps.body: The reviewer starts in a copy of the change with every coding agent's settings and every symlink left out.

steps.heading: Validate and verify
steps.body: The answer must match the schema and the lens, and every finding's quote must really be at the file and line it names.

steps.heading: Reduce and post
steps.body: The reduce job collects every saved run, decides by fixed rules, and posts one review.
